description: Election Commission  - Appoint Assistant Registering Officers for the Electoral Districts under Registration of Electors Act, No. 44 of 1980 - Reserved 2019.07.15
reasoning: This gazette notification specifically appoints Assistant Registering Officers for electoral districts under the Registration of Electors Act, No. 44 of 1980.
